body:
- **`<Stats src="./kpis.csv">` CSV-driven variant** — each row becomes a
  `<Stat>`. Column mapping via `title-col=`, `value-col=`, `delta-col=`,
  `description-col=`, `intent-col=`. Reuses datagrid's `parseCSV`.
- **`<ADR.Context>` / `<ADR.Decision>` / `<ADR.Consequences>`** —
  optional structured sub-components for authors who want auto-numbered
  section headings + TOC anchors.
- **ADR id auto-linking** — if body prose mentions `ADR-012`, transform
  to an anchor link to `#adr-012`.
